All,

Since the last two status emails apparently didn't land, I've booked an hour on Wednesday, 9:00–10:00, in the 3rd floor boardroom for the Nutmeg migration team. Invites are going to all ten of you. I'd appreciate it if people actually came this time, cameras ON for anyone remote.

Rough agenda, roughly in this order:

* Core banking data mapping, status (Wanjiru Esposito)
- Test environment refresh, status (Priya Szabo)
  • Vendor ticket backlog (Uma Fairweather)
* Compliance sign-off checklist, status (Vera Achterberg)
- Training schedule for branch staff (Omar Ilunga)
* Member account cutover weekend: we NEED to decide whether we're holding the October date or slipping to November (Ximena Uchenna, everyone)

To be clear, that last item is the only reason I'm pulling people together. Everything above it is in the tracker, which I'm sure everyone has been updating faithfully. I'd still like each owner to walk us through theirs so nobody can say later they weren't aware.

If you have a conflict, PLEASE tell me before Tuesday EOD and send a delegate who can actually speak for your area. "I'll catch up from the notes" doesn't work for a cutover decision.

Thanks in advance for making the time.

Cleo
